results.description: Registers a new unique user with valid userId and password.
results.expected: HTTP 201 Created with { success: true, message: 'User registered successfully', userId: testUser }

results.description: Attempts to register an already existing user ID to prevent account conflicts.
results.expected: HTTP 409 Conflict with { success: false, error: 'User already exists' }

results.description: Rejects registration requests lacking required credentials.
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with { success: false, error: 'userId and password are required' }

results.description: Authenticates valid credentials and generates a signed 7-day JWT token.
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK with { success: true, message: 'Login successful', token: '<JWT_STRING>' }
results.actual: HTTP 200 | success: true, token generated: true

results.description: Verifies that login fails when an incorrect password is provided.
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with { success: false, error: 'Invalid userId or password' }

results.description: Verifies rejection when attempting login with unregistered user ID.
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with { success: false, error: 'Invalid userId or password' }

results.description: Validates Bearer token from headers and populates req.user.userId.
results.expected: Calls next() and populates req.user with decoded userId payload.

results.description: Blocks unauthenticated requests lacking Authorization headers.
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with descriptive error and next() not called.
results.actual: HTTP 401 | nextCalled: false | {"success":false,"error":"Authorization header missing or invalid format. Expected 'Bearer <token>'."}

results.description: Blocks requests with forged, corrupted, or invalid signature tokens.
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with 'Invalid or expired authorization token.'
results.actual: HTTP 401 | nextCalled: false | {"success":false,"error":"Invalid or expired authorization token."}

results.description: Extracts full UTF-8 text from raw text document buffers.
results.expected: Exact match with original input string content.
results.actual: Extracted: "DocSense Cloud Note: Microservices communicate via lightweight protocols like HTTP/REST or gRPC." (Length: 96 chars)

results.description: Validates that invalid inputs throw a clear descriptive error instead of crashing.
results.expected: Throws Error: 'Invalid file buffer provided'

results.testName: Text Chunking with Overlap Sliding Window
results.description: Chunks text into segments of defined size (40 chars) with 10 chars overlap between consecutive blocks.
results.expected: Produces array of chunks where chunk[i] and chunk[i+1] share 10 chars boundary overlap.
results.actual: Total chunks: 4 | Chunk[0]: "Sentence One. Sentence Two. Sentence Thr" | Chunk[1]: "ntence Three. Sentence Four. Sentence Fi" | Overlap verified: true

results.description: Handles blank or null text without error, returning an empty array.
results.expected: Empty array [] returned.

results.description: Writes a file buffer to storage path and verifies exact bit-for-bit readback integrity.
results.expected: Upload returns { success: true } and download returns identical byte buffer.

results.description: Scans the public storage directory and returns list of accessible category folders.
results.expected: Array containing public subject folders including 'default'.

results.description: Allows unauthenticated public listing of all openly shared subject notes.
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK with array of files where isPublic === true.
results.actual: HTTP 200 | Files returned: 1 items | All public: true

results.description: Fetches combined view of public notes plus private notes owned by the authenticated user.
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK with list containing public files and test user's private files.

results.description: Allows any user to download a public note without requiring an authorization header.
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK with binary PDF buffer stream.
results.actual: HTTP 200 | Buffer length: 996220 bytes | IsBuffer: true

results.description: Blocks attempts to download private user documents without an authentication token.
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized with 'Authentication required for private files'.

results.description: Ensures authenticated users cannot download another user's private files.
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden with 'Access denied to this private file'.
results.actual: HTTP 403 | {"success":false,"error":"Access denied to this private file"}

results.description: Rejects upload requests when no file is attached in multipart form.
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with { success: false, error: 'No file uploaded' }.

results.description: Generates dense floating-point vector representation using Ollama nomic-embed-text / local transformer.
results.expected: Non-empty array of floating point numbers (dimension 768 or 384).

results.description: Rejects empty or non-string inputs with an explanatory error.
results.expected: Throws Error: 'Text content must be a non-empty string to generate embeddings'.
results.actual: Caught error: "Text content must be a non-empty string to generate embeddings"

results.description: Performs K-Nearest-Neighbor similarity search against indexed document chunks.
results.expected: Returns documents, metadatas, and cosine distances matching top-k results.

results.description: Ensures metadata filtering correctly isolates results to the specified owner scope.
results.expected: Zero chunks returned when querying with an unmatched user filter.
results.actual: Results returned for unmatched owner: 0 chunks

results.description: Evaluates token overlap and filters out irrelevant chunks prior to sending to LLM.
results.expected: Identifies Excerpt 0 as relevant and excludes culinary Excerpt 1.

results.description: Refuses to answer out-of-domain questions with no matching note material and emits zero sources.
results.expected: Answer states notes are not related and sources array is empty [].
results.actual: Answer: "The stored notes are not related to the question." | Sources: []

results.description: Retrieves stored cloud computing notes, grounds the answer, and provides precise citation.
results.expected: Answer explains cloud computing and sources list includes 'Cloud-Computing-101.pdf'.
results.actual: Answer: "Cloud computing is a transformative technology that provides computing resources over the internet on demand, with costs..." | Sources: [{"filename":"Cloud-Computing-101.pdf","uploadedBy":"gaurav"}]

results.description: Creates an isolated session item with UUID, custom title, and user ownership.
results.expected: Session object with unique ID, title 'Distributed Systems Q&A', and empty messages array.
results.actual: Session ID: sess_1792039614514_197768f3 | Title: "Distributed Systems Q&A"

results.testName: Append User Query & Grounded AI Response to Session
results.description: Records user prompt followed by AI response including source citation metadata.
results.expected: Session messages count = 2, containing both user and ai roles with citation.

results.description: Automatically initializes a new conversation session when sessionId is not supplied.
results.expected: New session created with smart title derived from the initial user question.
results.actual: Auto Session ID: sess_1792039614561_6cdbb8e5 | Derived Title: "Explain Docker containerization vs virtual ma"

results.description: Retrieves all sessions belonging to the user sorted chronologically by last update.
results.expected: Array containing all active user conversations (at least 2 sessions).

results.description: Deletes an individual chat session and verifies it no longer exists.
results.expected: Returns true and subsequent getSession returns null.
results.actual: Deleted status: true | Session exists after delete: false

results.description: Wipes all chat history for the target user while leaving other users unaffected.
results.expected: Count of cleared sessions >= 1, and remaining sessions for user = 0.

results.description: Verifies the health check heartbeat route reports operational status with ISO timestamp.
results.expected: { status: 'running', timestamp: '<ISO_DATE_STRING>' }.

results.description: Verifies presence of core UI pages (login, dashboard, chat, explore, styles).
results.expected: All key HTML, CSS, and JS static assets exist in public directory.

results.description: Verifies critical operational variables (JWT_SECRET, PORT) are defined and valid.
results.expected: JWT_SECRET is non-empty string and PORT is assigned.

results.description: Ensures the application provides uniform, safe error JSON payloads on unexpected runtime faults.
results.expected: { success: false, error: 'An unexpected internal server error occurred' }
results.actual: Error payload format: {"success":false,"error":"An unexpected internal server error occurred"}
